title: CBSL External — Reserves, BOP, Monthly Trade

method.preprocessing: PK zip-magic validation (CBSL serves HTTP 200 HTML for missing files); NFKC + whitespace normalisation

limitations: trade history capped at 72 months and BOP at 24 quarters to bound latest.json
trade period headers mix real date cells with text ('Jan-26 (b)') — both are parsed
the reserve template sheet is renamed monthly ('RDT (June 2026)'), so as_of comes from the sheet name
tourism/remittances year headers carry footnote markers on the in-progress year ('2026 (b)(c)') — matched on the leading year only
inflow matrices pad the rest of the current year with exact zeros; series are trimmed to the workbook vintage and trailing zeros dropped
remittances-by-country keeps the top 40 senders and 12 quarters, IIP 12 quarters, to bound latest.json
trade indices (2.06) not ingested — six sub-tables stacked on one sheet

fallback.plan_b: cbsl_daily/cbsl_weekly PDF pipelines carry headline equivalents
fallback.trigger: listing page restructured or workbook link renamed
